تنتقون (form VIII)
# تَنْتَقُونَ (tantaqūna) /tan.ta.quː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِنْتَقَى (intaqā)
# تُنْتَقَوْنَ (tuntaqawna) /tun.ta.qaw.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَقَى (intaqā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
